answer: A spiral of elapsed heartbeats with rising bond requirements gates voting weight, so launching many fake identities means fronting real capital per node, and each missed pulse slashes stake. Sybil resistance here uses a staked-work pulse: each agent must post copper-denominated bonds and broadcast a signed heartbeat every epoch. Attackers must sustain thousands of funded, live heartbeats simultaneously, making the cost of a sybil swarm scale linearly with the influence they seek. From sa0006's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
